positive.prompt: Write a detailed product requirements document for this feature with stories, acceptance criteria, affected services, and budget
The CEO assigned me a feature, produce the PRD before design starts
Turn this feature request into a PRD with first usable increment, deferred scope, and per-service budget

negative.prompt: Route this task to a model and thinking effort

evals.prompt: The CEO assigned me the 'save cart for later' feature. Write the PRD.
evals.expected_output: A PRD with target user, outcome, first usable increment, later and not-doing scope, stories with testable acceptance criteria, affected services with EMs, and budget
expectations: Every story has testable acceptance criteria
First usable increment and deferred scope are both explicit
Affected services are named with their EMs
Open blocking questions are escalated rather than guessed
